verses.gurmukhi: ਚੰਨਣੁ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਸੁਬਾਸੁ ਦੇ ਚੰਨਣੁ ਕਰਦਾ ਬਿਰਖ ਸਬਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: cha(n)nan birakh subaas dhe cha(n)nan karadhaa birakh sabaae|

en.bdb: Giving fragrance to all trees, the sandalwood tree makes them fragrant.

verses.gurmukhi: ਖਹਦੇ ਵਾਂਸਹੁਂ ਅਗਿ ਧੁਖਿ ਆਪਿ ਜਲੈ ਪਰਵਾਰੁ ਜਲਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: khahadhe vaa(n)sahu(n) ag dhukh aap jalai paravaar jalaae|

en.bdb: By the friction of the bamboos (on the other hand) the bamboo itself gets burnt and burns the whole family (of bamboos).

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੁਲਹ ਜਿਵੈ ਪੰਖੇਰੂਆ ਫਾਸੈ ਆਪਿ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਫਹਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: muleh jivai pa(n)kherooaa faasai aap kuTa(n)b fahaae|

en.bdb: Twithering quail not only gets caught but also makes the whole family ensnared.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਸਟ ਧਾਤੁ ਹੁਇ ਪਰਬਤਹੁ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਦਿਖਲਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: asaT dhaat hui parabatahu paaras kar ka(n)chan dhikhalaae|

en.bdb: The eight metals found in the mountains are converted into gold by the philosopher's stone.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗਣਿਕਾ ਵਾੜੈ ਜਾਇ ਕੈ ਹੋਵਨਿ ਰੋਗੀ ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: ganikaa vaaRai jai kai hovan rogee paap kamaae|

en.bdb: The people going to the prostitutes earn sins besides contagious diseases.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੀਏ ਆਵਨਿ ਵੈਦ ਘਰ ਦਾਰੂ ਦੇ ਦੇ ਰੋਗੁ ਮਿਟਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: dhukhe'ee aavan vaidh ghar dhaaroo dhe dhe rog miTaae|

en.bdb: The sufferers from a disease come to the physician and he giving medicine cures them.
Because of the nature of the company kept, one becomes good or bad.
